Cookies.metaDescription: What clusterdestartups.org stores in your browser, when Google measurement cookies run, and how to accept or reject them.
Cookies.title: Cookie notice

sections.heading: What cookies are
paragraphs: A cookie is a small file a site can store in your browser. This site also uses the browser’s local storage (localStorage) to remember a preference on your device.
The controller of this site is Clúster de Startups e Innovación (CSI) A.C. If you have questions about this notice, write to hola@clusterdestartups.org.

sections.heading: What we store on this site
paragraphs: The HTML of every page includes Google Analytics 4, measurement ID G-84QLB6EYLV, and the Google Tag Manager container GTM-P4W4WZCS.

Before that container loads, an inline script sets Google Consent Mode. By default it denies ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization, and analytics_storage. Those four signals start as granted only if the localStorage key csi-consent already has the value granted. functionality_storage and security_storage stay granted because the site needs them to work; they are not used for measurement or advertising.

We store two keys in localStorage. csi-consent remembers whether you accepted or rejected measurement. csi-theme stores whether you prefer the light or dark theme and is not a tracking cookie. Google measurement cookies run only after you accept. If you reject, they stay off.

sections.heading: How to accept or reject
paragraphs: When you arrive, a notice offers two choices: Accept and Reject.

If you choose Accept, we store csi-consent with the value granted and call gtag('consent', 'update') to grant ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization, and analytics_storage. Google measurement cookies can be set from that moment.
If you choose Reject, we store csi-consent with the value denied and update consent to denied. Measurement cookies stay off.

sections.heading: How to change your mind
paragraphs: Delete the localStorage key csi-consent and reload the page. The notice will appear again so you can choose once more.
You can also clear this site’s cookies and site data from your browser controls.

sections.heading: Privacy notice
paragraphs: The contact form does not use cookies. How we handle the data you send is explained in the privacy notice.
